Give each customer their own time

Three steps. Each person gets their own date and time, and only sees their own in the email.

1
Find the customer

The list on the left has every recipient. Tap a name to highlight, or scroll to find them.

→
2
Drag onto a time

Hold the name and drop it on an open spot. That's their new time. Drag again to move it.

→
3
Hit Next when done

When everyone has a time, head to Send timing. The email shows their date and time only.

To remove a time: click the booked slot on the calendar and pick "Remove."
To change a time: drag the name to a different open spot. The old time clears automatically.

Read pages from your website

Paste any page from your site — services, pricing, FAQ, contact. Your AI reads it once and uses what it learned to answer customer questions on calls and chats. Add 3–5 pages and your AI sounds way smarter.

Most contractors get great results with 3–5 URLs covering services, pricing, and FAQs.

Or import from Google

Pull from your existing docs, sheets, and PDFs. We only read what you pick — never your whole Drive.

Connected

Your data stays yours. Files import once and live only in your account's KB. We never share your tokens or Drive content with other users.

Widget

Approved domains

Your widget will only load on these domains. Add the website where you want to install it.

Embed code

Paste this snippet just before the </body> tag on your website. Works on WordPress, Squarespace, Wix, Webflow, and custom HTML.

<script src="https://justgotalead.com/<your_account_id>/widget.js"></script>
